message.content:
This is a telescopic magnifier without a reticle, used with red dot sights on firearms. The likely classification is in heading 9005 (binoculars, monoculars, other optical telescopes) or heading 9013 (telescopic sights for firearms are in 9005.10 or 9013.10).

Heading 9013.10 covers "Telescopic sights for fitting to arms; periscopes; telescopes designed to form parts of machines, appliances, instruments or apparatus of chapter 90 or section XVI." Customs rulings on magnifiers for red dot sights (for example, NY rulings on the "3x magnifier") have classified them in 9005.80 as other monocular instruments. The product is not a telescopic sight itself because it has no reticle, and it is a standalone monocular-type telescope usable for general observation. The description stresses "reticle-free" and "not designed for use with infrared light" and "wildlife observation," which points to 9005.80.

Within 9005.80, the subheadings are 9005.80.20 (infrared/ night vision?) and 9005.80.40 (monocular, other), and 9005.80.60 (other). The statistical suffix for monoculars is 9005.80.4000, and "other" is 9005.80.6000. Since this is a monocular-type telescope, I choose 9005.80.4000.
